review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: By combining international partnerships with local expertise, the company delivers energy-efficient solutions that save time and resources. The person in this role will lead technical pre-sales activities for low-current and smart building solutions, including understanding client requirements, designing system architectures, and preparing proposals and technical offers. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong technical expertise in low-current systems (e.g., CCTV, access control, fire alarms, data networks, audio/visual, smart home systems). Candidates should possess customer-facing skills, including requirements gathering, presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders, and maintaining professional client relationships. Several years of experience in pre-sales or design roles within low-current, ELV, or smart building technologies is highly beneficial.
